SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 03 and 04
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 03:18:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 01 and 02
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 01:18:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 02:28:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::0df34342ad6198112b768fc7d6f4ec6cc5fe2fdb593bdbfcffefbc14b5448cd3 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 19:31:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::b06313f30f2e45c764f669ab6bdc82e9c24a35a3f4d8a7ff9a02285be7281070 */
SELECT * FROM (
WITH chrons AS (
    SELECT
        c.chron_id,
        c.business_date
    FROM risk_prod.dim_chron c
    WHERE c.canonical_source = '1'
      AND c.chron_status = 'SUCCESS'
      AND c.business_date IN ('2025-06-24')
),
fact_pnl AS (
	SELECT
	  c.business_date,
	  pnl.dim_date AS pnl_date,
	  pnl.dim_hierarchy_node_id,
	  h.node_path,
	  pnl.analytic_value
	FROM chrons c
	JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node h 
	  ON c.chron_id = h.chron_id
        AND h.hierarchy_type = 'ACCOUNT'
	  AND h.node_level <= 2
	JOIN risk_prod.fact_analytic_md_pnl pnl 
	  ON pnl.chron_id = c.chron_id
	  AND h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = pnl.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	  AND pnl.portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
)
SELECT
  pnl.business_date "Business Date",
  pnl_date "PnL Date",
  rh.node_path,
  analytic_value
FROM fact_pnl pnl
JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node rh on rh.business_date = pnl.business_date and rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id = pnl.dim_hierarchy_node_id
WHERE rh.node_level <= 2 
   AND rh.hierarchy_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND ( rh.node_path LIKE '%CPPIB-ALL%' )
ORDER BY pnl.business_date, pnl_date) T LIMIT 0

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 19:01:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),

            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 13:23:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH

  LATEST_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT MAX(source_business_date) AS bdate, MAX(chron_id) AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron WHERE CANONICAL_SOURCE = '1'),

  SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT source_business_date AS bdate, chron_id AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron WHERE CANONICAL_SOURCE = '1' AND
  source_business_date= date'2025-06-23'), 

  BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT * FROM SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE) -- Select your date here

SELECT
  bd.bdate                                          AS "Business Date",
  currency.ISO_CURRENCY_CODE                        AS "Currency",
  curve.CURVE_VALUE                                 AS "Curve",
  curve_type.CURVE_TYPE_VALUE                       AS "Curve Type",
  cs01.DATA_SOURCE                                  AS "Data Source",
  cs01.FINAL_VALUE                                  AS "Final Value",
  cs01.INITIAL_VALUE                                AS "Initial Value",
  cs01.OVERRIDE_SOURCE                              AS "Override Source",
  cs01.OVERRIDE_VALUE                               AS "Override Value",
  term.TERM_VALUE                                   AS "Tenor" ,
  COALESCE ( (1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * cs01.final_value      AS CAD_VALUE,
  cs01.portfolio_type,
  cs01.scaling_type,
  cs01.pos_id,
  cs01.dim_hierarchy_node_id
FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_md cs01
JOIN risk_prod.dim_calc_currency currency
ON cs01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
JOIN risk_prod.dim_calc_term term
ON cs01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
AND term.CALC_DIM_TYPE   = 'TERM'
JOIN risk_prod.dim_calc_curve curve
ON cs01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
AND curve.CALC_DIM_TYPE   = 'CURVE'
JOIN risk_prod.dim_calc_curve_type curve_type
ON cs01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
AND curve_type.CALC_DIM_TYPE   = 'CURVE_TYPE'
LEFT JOIN risk_prod.fact_fx_rate fx
ON currency.iso_currency_code     = fx.to_currency
AND currency.chron_id             = fx.chron_id
AND fx.from_currency              = 'CAD'
AND fx.rate_type                  = 'CROSS'
WHERE
cs01.chron_id = bd.chron_id

--AND curve_type.curve_type_value = 'ZERO'

    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-03'
)
select a.*, b.*, c.*, f.*, d.*, e.*, p.*
from
(
select 
  ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
  ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
  null as id_enterprise_holding,
  ss.abor_security_name as security_name,
  ss.abor_security_number as security_no,
  ss.quotation_currency_code as currency,
  sec.abor_country_id as country_code,
  ss.abor_security_type_id as security_type_code,	   
  ss.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
  ss.security_group_id as security_group_code,	   
  ss.security_group_name,
  '48' as instrument_type_code,

  sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
  ss.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,	   
  ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,
  cast(ss.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
  ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc
from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
left join RankedSecurities sec 
    on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
where ss.business_date = '2025-06-03'
and sec.rn = 1) as a

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs

		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 16:38:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::0cbc986ba6800a4b8c422bfeee637cf75f46b80a735376d9ff5b41e9546e58d1 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-21')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-21')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-21')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

WITH

        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-18')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-18')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp

        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-18')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-18')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,

WITH statestreet_identifiers AS (
    SELECT
        ss.asset_id as asset_id,
        ss.sedol AS ss_sedol,
        ss.isin AS ss_isin,
        COALESCE(si1.cppib_sec_id, si2.cppib_sec_id, si3.cppib_sec_id) AS cppib_sec_id,
        COALESCE(si1.cusip, si2.cusip, si3.cusip, ss.asset_id) AS cusip, -- Defaults to asset_id
        COALESCE(si1.sedol, si2.sedol, si3.sedol) AS si_sedol,
        COALESCE(si1.isin, si2.isin, si3.isin) AS si_isin,
        COALESCE(si1.bloomberg_unique_id, si2.bloomberg_unique_id, si3.bloomberg_unique_id) AS bloomberg_unique_id,
        COALESCE(si1.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, si2.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, si3.sec_typ_lvl1_nm) AS sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        COALESCE(si1.sec_nm, si2.sec_nm, si3.sec_nm) AS securityName,
        ss.bus_date
    FROM asset.statestreet_custody_security_identifiers ss
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si1
        ON ss.sedol = si1.sedol
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si2
        ON ss.asset_id = si2.cusip
        AND ss.sedol <> si1.sedol -- Only join on CUSIP if SEDOL didn't match
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si3
        ON ss.isin = si3.isin
        AND ss.sedol <> si1.sedol
        AND ss.asset_id <> si2.cusip -- Only join on ISIN if neither SEDOL nor CUSIP matched
    WHERE ss.bus_date = date_parse('2025-06-24', '%Y-%m-%d')
        AND COALESCE(si1.bloomberg_unique_id, si2.bloomberg_unique_id, si3.bloomberg_unique_id) IS NOT NULL
        AND si1.del_dt IS NULL
        AND si2.del_dt IS NULL
        AND si3.del_dt IS NULL
),

equities AS (
    SELECT
        aeu.bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag,
        equity.*
    FROM statestreet_identifiers equity
    JOIN asset.asset_equity_universe aeu
        ON equity.cppib_sec_id = aeu.cppib_sec_id
    WHERE aeu.bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag = 'Y'
),

bonds AS (
    SELECT
        '' AS bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag,
        bond.*
    FROM statestreet_identifiers bond
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM equities eq
        WHERE eq.asset_id = bond.asset_id
    )
),

identifiers AS (
    SELECT * FROM equities
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM bonds
),

custody_holdings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        asset_id as asset_id,
        invest_type_cd AS security_type_code
    FROM df_trusted_prod.statestreet_custody_holdings
    WHERE bus_date = date_parse('2025-06-24', '%Y-%m-%d')
),

security_details AS (
    SELECT
        t.cppib_sec_id,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Bond' THEN ab.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Equity' THEN ae.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Money market' THEN amm.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Entitlement' THEN aw.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ticker_exchange,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Bond' THEN ab.issue_country_iso
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Equity' THEN ae.issue_country_iso
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Money market' THEN amm.issue_country_iso
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Entitlement' THEN aw.issue_country_iso
            ELSE NULL
        END AS issuer_country,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Bond' THEN ab.trade_currency_code
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Equity' THEN ae.trade_currency_code
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Money market' THEN amm.trade_currency_code
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Entitlement' THEN aw.trade_currency_code
            ELSE NULL
        END AS trading_currency
    FROM identifiers t
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_bond_universe ab
        ON t.cppib_sec_id = ab.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity_universe ae
        ON t.cppib_sec_id = ae.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_money_market amm
        ON t.cppib_sec_id = amm.cppib_sec_id
        AND amm.business_date = date_parse('2025-06-24', '%Y-%m-%d')
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants_universe aw
        ON t.cppib_sec_id = aw.cppib_sec_id

    FROM reference.scd_securities

(case when g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code is not null then g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code
      when l.country_of_exposure_code is not null then l.country_of_exposure_code
      when a.exposure_country_code is not null then a.exposure_country_code

	   sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
	   sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
	   sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,

	   ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
	   ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,

	left join RankedSecurities sec

	left join reference.scd_party_issuer ref

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 05:43:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc

  staging.sentry_transactions_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_security_src_business_date,

  NULL AS fx_spot,

  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  staging.transaction_code AS transaction_code,
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'N' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier and staging.run_id = reference.run_id
WHERE
  staging.run_id = '798e0262-1b87-45f5-92cf-d84859e91dc8'

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH MaxBusinessDates AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten) AS max_ist_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_seclvl) AS max_psl_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite) AS max_secc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_pcc_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) AS max_scds_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_party_issuer) AS max_spi_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_epc_bd
        
)
SELECT
    psl.business_date,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel3 as investment_structure_level_03,
    ist.investmentstructurelevel4 as investment_structure_level_04 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel5 as investment_structure_level_05 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel6 as investment_structure_level_06 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel7 as investment_structure_level_07 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel8 as investment_structure_level_08 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel9 as investment_structure_level_09 ,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel10 as investment_structure_level_10 ,
    ist.model_portfolio_name, 
    psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_2 as quoted_currency,
    psl.aggregation_level_3 as scd_security_id,
    psl.aggregation_level_4,
    psl.aggregation_level_5,
    secc.esm_security_name,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency,
    psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency,
    psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency, 
    psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency, 
    psl.market_value_reporting_currency, 
    psl.market_value_quotation_currency,
    coalesce (pcc.epm_party_name, epc.epm_party_name) as issuer,
    upcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent
FROM 
    performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
    
LEFT JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist
    ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = ist.model_portfolio
    AND ist.business_date = (select max_ist_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
    AND ist.investmentstructure IN ('CPPIB_F24')
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities scds
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = scds.abor_security_id
    AND scds.business_date = (select max_scds_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
	on scds.abor_issuer_id = spi.party_id
	and spi.business_date = (select max_spi_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite epc
	on epc.party_id = spi.party_id 
	and epc.business_date = (select max_epc_bd from MaxBusinessDates)
LEFT JOIN cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = secc.abor_security_id

(

    concat(CAST(h.account_id AS varchar), '00', lpad(CAST(h.security_identifier AS varchar), 4, '0')) id_instrument,

    s.currency deal_local_currency,

    h.market_value_net_local carrying_value_local_cur_deal,
    h.market_value_net_base carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
    h.market_value_accrued_net_local carrying_value_inc_adj_local_cur,
    (CASE WHEN trim(i.country_of_exposure) = '' THEN '' ELSE UPPER(i.country_of_exposure) END) country_of_exposure,
    i.currency_of_exposure,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    i.developed_or_emerging,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_base, 0) distribution_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_local, 0) distribution_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_base, 0) distribution_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_local, 0) distribution_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_base, 0) distribution_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_local, 0) distribution_ytd_local_cur,
    0 as dpi_base_itd,
    0 as dpi_local_itd,
    (CASE WHEN trim(s.ownership_pct) = '' THEN '0.00 %' ELSE concat(CAST(CAST(CAST(s.ownership_pct AS decimal(38,12)) * 100 AS decimal(10,2)) AS varchar), ' %') END) equity_ownership_percentage,
    i.region geographic_focus,
    i.gics_sector industry_focus,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_base_itd,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_local_itd,
    null as key_investment_style,
    0 as multiple_base_currency_itd,
    0 as multiple_local_currency_itd,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_local_cur,
    s.reporting_name,
    s.ir_classification primary_investment_category,
    null as secondary_investment_category,
    null as segmentation,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    null as vintage_year
  from holdings.ci_sentry_holdings h
  join reference.ci_sentry_security s on h.security_identifier = s.security_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN s.start_date and s.end_date
  join reference.ci_sentry_issuer i on s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN i.start_date and i.end_date
  left join (
    select
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,
      hierarchy_group,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_base
    from trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_hierarchy
    where hierarchy_group = 'Paid-In Distributions'
    group by
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,
      hierarchy_group
  ) cfh on h.business_date = cfh.business_date and s.security_identifier = cfh.security_identifier and h.account_id = cfh.account_id

    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-24'
)

from
(
select 
  ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
  ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
  null as id_enterprise_holding,
  ss.abor_security_name as security_name,

  ss.quotation_currency_code as currency,
  sec.abor_country_id as country_code,

  ss.security_group_id as security_group_code,

  sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
  ss.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,	   
  ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,
  cast(ss.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
  ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc

left join RankedSecurities sec

where ss.business_date = '2025-06-24'
and sec.rn = 1) as a
